ConvexAuthProvider.name: storageMode
ConvexAuthProvider.description:
`"cookies"` stores the session in HttpOnly cookies managed by an SSR
adapter. The access token lives in memory only, the refresh token never
reaches the browser, and session-minting writes go through the adapter's
proxy endpoint (`apiRoute`). `storage` and URL token ingestion are
disabled in this mode.

ConvexAuthProvider.name: apiRoute
ConvexAuthProvider.description: Proxy endpoint for session-minting actions in cookie mode. Defaults to `/api/auth`.

ConvexAuthProvider.name: initialUser
ConvexAuthProvider.description: Server-resolved user, so `isAuthenticated` is correct on first paint.

ConvexAuthProvider.name: serverState
ConvexAuthProvider.description:
Fresh server-resolved state, re-delivered by the SSR adapter on each
server render. In cookie mode the provider re-seeds token/sessionId when
`_timeFetched` advances, so a middleware-rotated session reaches the
mounted client; a stale payload (framework cache) is ignored via the
watermark. Only meaningful with `storageMode: "cookies"`.

ConvexAuthProvider.name: onAuthChange
ConvexAuthProvider.description:
Called when the session transitions between authenticated and
unauthenticated (not on mount). SSR adapters use it to invalidate
framework caches — e.g. Next.js's Router Cache — after sign-in/sign-out.

ConvexAuthProvider.name: requireLandingVerifier
ConvexAuthProvider.description:
Token mode only: require URL session-triple landings
(`?token=&refreshToken=`) to carry a `landingVerifier` param matching
this browser's verifier cookie — binds OAuth/magic-link landings to the
browser that initiated the flow. Defaults to `true`. Set `false` when
flows are initiated outside the browser (e.g. a server calling
`signInWithRedirect`) or when magic links must open in a different
browser than the requesting one. Cookie mode enforces the same binding
at the SSR boundary via the middleware's `requireLandingVerifier`.

ConvexAdminDashboard.name: onBanUser
ConvexAdminDashboard.type: (userId: string, reason: string, until: number) => void

ConvexAuthSignInPage.name: forgotPasswordHref

ConvexChangeEmailForm.name: currentEmail
ConvexChangeEmailForm.description: The user's current email, displayed read-only above the new-email field.

ConvexChangeEmailForm.name: verifyCallbackUrl
ConvexChangeEmailForm.description:
Absolute URL of the verify-email page on this app. Better-Auth
appends `?token=…` to it for the change-confirmation email.

ConvexEnableTwoFactorForm.name: issuer
ConvexEnableTwoFactorForm.description: Authenticator label shown alongside the account (e.g. "Pile").

ConvexEnableTwoFactorForm.name: renderQR
ConvexEnableTwoFactorForm.description:
Optional QR renderer. Receives the `otpauth://` URI. When omitted,
only the manually-enterable secret is shown — still a complete
enrollment path. Keeps the package free of a QR dependency.

ConvexEnableTwoFactorForm.name: onEnrolled
ConvexEnableTwoFactorForm.description: Fired once enrollment is fully confirmed (after the backup step).

ConvexForgotPasswordForm.name: resetPasswordUrl
ConvexForgotPasswordForm.description:
Absolute URL of the reset-password page on this app. Better-Auth
appends `?token=…` to it before sending the email.

ConvexProfileEditForm.name: showImageField
ConvexProfileEditForm.description:
Whether to show the image URL field. Defaults to true. Set to
false for consumers that don't surface avatar editing.

ConvexProfileImageUploader.name: uploadFile
ConvexProfileImageUploader.description:
Consumer-provided upload strategy. Receives the picked file (a
browser `File`/`Blob` on web, a `Blob` or a base64/URI string on
React Native) and MUST return the canonical URL of the uploaded
image (the URL that will be stored on the user). The package
never sees the storage backend.

ConvexResetPasswordForm.name: token
ConvexResetPasswordForm.description: Reset token from the recovery email (typically `?token=…`).

ConvexResetPasswordForm.name: minPasswordLength
ConvexResetPasswordForm.description:
Minimum new-password length to enforce client-side. Defaults to
12 (matches the package's server-side `minPasswordLength` default).
The server is authoritative either way.

ConvexSessionList.name: showRevokeOthersAction
ConvexSessionList.description:
Render a "Revoke all other sessions" button next to the title.
Defaults to true. Hides when no other sessions exist.

ConvexVerifyEmailScreen.name: token
ConvexVerifyEmailScreen.description: Token from the verification email's `?token=…` param.

ConvexVerifyEmailScreen.name: userEmail
ConvexVerifyEmailScreen.description:
The current user's email, if signed in. Required to enable the
resend-verification button. If absent, the resend button is
hidden (no way to know which email to resend to).

ConvexVerifyEmailScreen.name: resendCallbackUrl
ConvexVerifyEmailScreen.description:
Absolute URL of this verify-email page on this app. Better-Auth
appends a fresh `?token=…` to it for the resent email.

ConvexVerifyEmailScreen.name: onVerified
ConvexVerifyEmailScreen.description: Called on successful verification (after the verify call returns ok).

ConvexVerifyTwoFactorForm.name: showTrustDevice
ConvexVerifyTwoFactorForm.description:
Show the "trust this device" checkbox (skips 2FA on this device for
the server's trust window). Defaults to true.

ConvexVerifyTwoFactorForm.name: onVerified
ConvexVerifyTwoFactorForm.description: Fired once the second factor is satisfied and the session is live.
